entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh? What is this place?
It's Kamoshida's castle.
The color...
A TV station?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No, you can clearly tell that it's not...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I think this is a recording studio for a TV station. But why is everything colored like that...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah. This place looks like a recording studio inside a TV station.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I think so. But why is everyone colored like that...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Are these guys part of Kamoshida's cognition?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Say, who the hell are you guys?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey! Don't ignore me—

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Whoa!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey! Look at that!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wait, is that... Kamoshida!?

entries.speaker: Veteran AD
entries.en: Cutting back from commercial!

entries.speaker: Veteran AD
entries.en: Seven, six, five seconds till start, four,[n]three...

entries.speaker: Bright Announcer
entries.en: And now, onto our "Hottest Meet-and-Greet" segment. This year marks the fourth year since the worldwide tournament...

entries.speaker: Bright Announcer
entries.en: Joining us today, is the captain of the boys' volleyball team that won the last worldwide tournament, Suguru Kamoshida.

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: Hello, I'm Kamoshida... I'm honored to be here.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's him! But... doesn't he look really young!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I have no idea what's going on... Let's just keep watching for now.

entries.speaker: Talkative MC
entries.en: My, that's some popularity! And that sure hasn't changed since you went pro!

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: N-Not at all. I'm really not that special.

entries.speaker: Talkative MC
entries.en: You can't really mean that now, can you?

entries.speaker: Bright Announcer
entries.en: Absolutely. You're currently appearing in a number of commercials, among other things...

entries.speaker: Bright Announcer
entries.en: And after you signed your professional contract, you donated half of your earnings to your home high school.

entries.speaker: Talkative MC
entries.en: That's right! No normal person could have gone through with that!

entries.speaker: Talkative MC
entries.en: Now, for today, we'd like to ask a special favor of you, Athlete Kamoshida...

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: Oh, sure!

entries.speaker: Talkative MC
entries.en: Ooh, it's so shiny!

entries.speaker: Talkative MC
entries.en: I can still remember that final spike you landed! Can you tell us how you felt the moment you won?

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: Um, well... I was thinking to myself, "I did it!"... I felt pretty happy at the time.

entries.speaker: Talkative MC
entries.en: Did you feel like you were under any pressure, being the captain and all?

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: That's true. I had my own practice, and I had to look after my teammates as well...

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: Keeping up with all the responsibilities of a captain was the toughest part.

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: Take right now for instance. I'm not that comfortable going in front of people, so...

entries.speaker: Talkative MC
entries.en: What, really? You could've fooled me.

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: Haha... Do I look really capable to other people?

entries.speaker: Bright Announcer
entries.en: Still though, I understand that feeling.

entries.speaker: Bright Announcer
entries.en: Any job that involves going in front of people is a lot of work, wouldn't you say?

entries.speaker: Bright Announcer
entries.en: Whenever the cameras are rolling, I can't help but put on an "act."

entries.speaker: Bright Announcer
entries.en: I guess you could say that it's hard to be myself...?

entries.speaker: Bright Announcer
entries.en: You're really amazing though, Kamoshida-san!

entries.speaker: Bright Announcer
entries.en: You looked so cool during that interview back when you won your gold medal!

entries.speaker: Talkative MC
entries.en: Kamoshida-san, back when she was in school, she used to be in the volleyball club. She was a big fan of yours!

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: Huh!?

entries.speaker: Bright Announcer
entries.en: Yes! I'd love to talk more with you after this, if you don't mind!

entries.speaker: Talkative MC
entries.en: Whoa whoa whoa! Are you trying to score on a live TV show!?

entries.speaker: Talkative MC
entries.en: Well, you heard her, Kamoshida-san. How do you respond!?

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: Huh!? Um, well...

entries.speaker: Talkative MC
entries.en: Wait, are you seriously blushing, Kamoshida-san?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It... It stopped? Yo, what was all that?
Kamoshida was young.
We should be in the Palace.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah, he was.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Also, I heard something about him winning a gold medal at the last tournament. Wasn't that supposed to be a long time ago...?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I don't remember leaving the Palace... And didn't Kamoshida look really young there?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Plus, I heard something about him winning a gold medal at the last tournament. Wasn't that supposed to be a long time ago...?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hm? A young Kamoshida...?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So does that mean... that was Kamoshida's past...?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Kamoshida's past!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yeah, since a Palace is the inside of a person's heart.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It wouldn't be strange for us to see manifestations of memories here that are significant to the person.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Things that they can't forget, or even, things that they want to forget, but can't...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I don't give a shit about that asshole's past!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Kamoshida probably doesn't want us to know either. He might flip out if we go digging around on our own.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: On the other hand though, if we understand the Palace ruler's heart better, we might be able to navigate this place better.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: "Know thy enemy"... as they say?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Exactly. We should keep our eyes out for similar doors going forward.
There are hidden doors throughout the Palace that contain memories of the Palace ruler's past.
Opening all of those doors may allow you to progress through the Palace more easily.
